pages.chat.cloud.body: This thread works on a copy of your desktop folder in the cloud. Take it back to continue on your desktop.
pages.chat.cloud.eraseBody: The files in the cloud, and the changes the cloud made to them, are deleted, and a turn that is running is stopped. The thread goes back to the desktop it came from.
pages.chat.cloud.eraseFailed: The cloud copy could not be erased. Try again.
pages.chat.cloud.reclaimPending: Take back requested: it starts when the running cloud turn ends.
pages.chat.cloud.requestFailed: The request could not be sent. Try again.
pages.chat.cloud.returningBody: This thread is being taken back to the desktop it came from. You can read it here; to continue, use the desktop app.
